---
title: "Forces"
---

## The interface

A force is any callable

```python
force(x, t, y, z, vy, vz) -> (fy, fz)
```

returning the force per unit length (N/m) along the global `y` and `z` axes,
from the horizontal position `x` of the nodes (m), the time `t` (s), and the
global position (`y`, `z`, m) and velocity (`vy`, `vz`, m/s) of the
structure. The components may be scalars or arrays broadcastable to the
nodes. The frame is the one of the [output
contract](simulation.qmd#the-output-contract).

- The beam is planar: it is called with `y = vy = 0` and only `fz` is used.
- The cable projects both components on its local normal and binormal; the
  along-span part is dropped. **The weight is already in the catenary
  equilibrium**: a cable force must not include it, and a
  [](`~slenderpy.force.core.Gravity`) passed to the cable solver is refused.
  The cable static solver takes its load with the same convention.

## Provided forces

[](`slenderpy.force.core`):

- [](`~slenderpy.force.core.Gravity`): the weight, `(0, -g m)`, for the beam;
- [](`~slenderpy.force.core.PointExcitation`): a sinusoidal vertical force
  applied at the node nearest a position, over a time window. The position
  must lie within the span; this is checked when the force is evaluated.

[](`slenderpy.force.wind`):

- wind models with `velocity(x, t) -> (wy, wz)`:
  [](`~slenderpy.force.wind.ConstantWind`),
  [](`~slenderpy.force.wind.UniformTurbulentWind`) (a Von Karman signal, the
  same along the span) and [](`~slenderpy.force.wind.TurbulentWindField`) (a
  correlated field along the span);
- [](`~slenderpy.force.wind.WindDrag`): the drag on a circular cylinder with
  the relative velocity, with a constant drag coefficient or
  [](`~slenderpy.force.air.cylinder_drag`) of the local Reynolds number.

[](`slenderpy.force.air`): the air density and viscosity
([](`~slenderpy.force.air.Air`)) and the cylinder drag coefficient.

## Composition

Provided forces add up with `+`:

```python
from slenderpy.force.core import Gravity, PointExcitation
from slenderpy.force.wind import ConstantWind, WindDrag

force = (
    Gravity(conductor.mass)
    + PointExcitation(frequency=5.0, amplitude=10.0, position=2.5)
    + WindDrag(diameter=conductor.diameter, wind=ConstantWind(10.0))
)
```

A plain function cannot take part in `+`; pass it alone, or wrap it in a
subclass of [](`~slenderpy.force.core.Force`).
